evidence.explanation: The investigator actively retrieves, compares, and evaluates records from multiple sources (arrest history, complaint history, dispatch audio, medical report) to build the case file.

secondary_categories.subcategory: A2.1 Uncodified visual or auditory information processing

evidence.quote: A slowed-frame audio pass done later picked up Marquez raising his voice and stepping into Alvarez's space almost three minutes before the takedown—something neither report mentioned.
evidence.explanation: Interpreting ambiguous audio/visual cues (tone, positioning, motion) that are not reducible to an explicit rule is a hallmark of uncodified perceptual processing.

evidence.quote: the conversation moved pretty quickly toward the take that the force was likely justified given Chen's corroboration and the resisting motion on camera
evidence.explanation: The investigator builds a working model of 'reasonableness' by integrating disparate evidence sources (footage, reports, corroboration) into a coherent causal account of the incident, which is a diagnostic/abstraction task rather than mere retrieval.

evidence.quote: I drafted the preliminary summary along those lines within the forty-eight-hour window we had for the Deputy Chief.
evidence.explanation: Composing a written preliminary summary for command is a literacy-based communication task.

evidence.quote: Day six, me, the sergeant, and two peer investigators... One of the other investigators raised the forty-second BWC gap, said it was worth flagging before we went further.
evidence.explanation: The case conference involves aligning multiple stakeholders (sergeant, peer investigators) toward a shared preliminary determination, requiring coordination of viewpoints and priorities, though the participant is not shown directing others' work.

not_observed_or_insufficient: A1.1 Strength - no physical exertion described by the participant
A1.2 Dexterity - no fine motor manipulation described
A1.3 Navigation - no physical movement through space described by the participant themselves
A2.3 Numeracy - no calculation or quantitative reasoning beyond simple distances/time is performed by the participant

A2.6 Creativity, planning, and resolution - the case handling follows fairly standard investigative sequencing rather than generating a novel solution; insufficient evidence of original problem-solving
A3.1 Serving and attending - no direct service interaction with a client is described
A3.2 Teaching, training, and coaching - not present
A3.3 Selling and influencing - the sergeant's framing could suggest influence, but this is attributed to the sergeant, not the participant's own task activity
ambiguities: A2.6 (planning/resolution) is borderline: sequencing the investigation, deciding when to escalate to a supplemental review, and adjusting the briefing could be read as non-routine problem resolution, but the text more strongly frames these as reactive evaluations of incoming evidence rather than active design of a novel course of action. Left out of secondary categories due to insufficient distinctiveness from A2.4/A2.5.

A3.4 (managing/coordinating) is ambiguous because the participant is a participant in, not clearly the leader of, the case conference; the evidence supports coordination among peers but does not show the participant directing others' work.

task_anchors.task_description: Intake evidence gathering: pulling complainant and officer background records, dispatch audio, and medical report to establish an initial case file.
Body-worn-camera review, including a later enhanced slowed-frame audio pass, to assess the force sequence.
Case conference deliberation with sergeant and peer investigators, followed by drafting a preliminary written summary for the Deputy Chief.
Integrating a late civilian eyewitness statement and a supplemental reliability review, then reconciling with the prior command briefing.
